_comment: Canonical values for checks/uniform.mjs. A number is px (within the gate's --tolerance), a string is compared exactly,
null means the majority of the run at each viewport and mode (the report prints the distribution: pick a value and write it here).
A value can be split by {"light", "dark"}, {"desktop", "phone"} or "desktop-light" and so on. * stands for one dotted segment.
Values with a source: lab/new-theme/astryx-ref/spec.json (components), as measured on the approved M2 overview by scripts/measure.mjs.

button.dropdown.*._source: Astryx 0.7.16 ButtonGroup: a grouped Button's outer corners take --radius-element (Button.js groupStyles); the ComboButton is the group of its Button and chevron IconButton

button.icon.md._source: Astryx 0.7.16 IconButton md (Button isIconOnly: height --size-element-md, aspect-ratio 1 / 1, padding 0, flex-shrink 0, the button's pill radius); label size for the glyph

button.icon.sm._source: Astryx 0.7.16 IconButton sm (height --size-element-sm, square, padding 0); a table cell holds the small one

field.*._source: Astryx 0.7.16 TextField and Select md, measured in M3 (STATE.md, M3 port): height --size-element-md, radius --radius-element, body size; formWidth is --aster-field-w (layout.css), desktop only; on a phone the field fills its row less the buttons on its line (formFill 0); a Diagnostics tool's field fills its cell (cellFill 0); a button on a field's line is --spacing-2 after it (buttonGap 8, Astryx Stack gap); border is Astryx's emphasized border (owner 2026-11-19: keep Astryx field border)

checkbox._source: Astryx 0.7.16 Checkbox, measured in M3 (STATE.md, M3 port): 24

radio._source: Astryx 0.7.16 Radio, measured in M3 (STATE.md, M3 port): 24

table.row.button._source: spec Table body row with sm Button

table.fold.td.first._source: spec Phone layout: collapsible table, host name cell (15, 16 inline start)

table.fold.td.stacked._source: spec Phone layout: dropped columns stacked under the first as supporting text

table.fold.row._source: spec Phone layout: collapsible table, each row a stack (grid) below 768

table.fold.td.actions._source: spec Phone layout: the row actions on a line of their own under the stack, inset like the cells (16 each side); every button inside the card (overflow 0)

table.layout.td._source: Diagnostics lays its tools out as the cells of one table row: a table cell's inset on the desktop (4 / 16 start), the card's content edge on a phone where the cells stack

table.kv.row.text._source: M2 overview System card (spec has no key/value table)

table.kv.row.wrap._source: luci.css phone layout: a key/value row too wide for a phone (the realtime legends) stacks as a grid; on the desktop every row is a table row

table.kv.td.key._source: M2 overview System card: the key column flush with the card (MetadataList)

table.progress.td._source: M2 overview Memory and Storage cards

card._source: spec Card (default); gap is the overview grid gap; lastRule: no rule under a card's last row (Astryx TableCell drops the last body row's divider)

heading.card._source: Astryx settings and dashboard templates: a section title is Heading 3 (layout/SPEC.md; was spec Heading h2, 22)

heading.inner._source: Heading 4 under a Heading 3 card title (dashboard template card titles; layout/SPEC.md)

heading._source: Astryx Heading levels (qa2 #11): a title is Heading 1, 2, 3 or 4 as the tokens size them; an <abbr> in it has no dotted rule

tab._source: Astryx 0.7.16 Tabs md, measured in M3 (STATE.md, M3 port): 36 high, the selected tab marked by a 2 px accent pill

form.label._source: Astryx Field layout, measured in M3 (STATE.md, M3 port): the label column --aster-form-label-w (layout.css) on desktop; on phone the label spans the row

form.row._source: Astryx Field layout: a form row spans its card's (or dialog's) content box (fill 0)

nav.item._source: Astryx 0.7.16 SideNavSection items: flex column, gap --spacing-0-5; the theme keeps it inside a group too, so a hovered row never touches the selected one

tooltip._source: Astryx 0.7.16 Tooltip, measured: text padding 4px 8px, radius 16 (container), 15px body, no arrow, 4 from the anchor; its words fit the box (scrollWidth - clientWidth); every word inside in its ink (AA against the fill); a key/value line at most two lines; as wide as its words up to max-width 300, so no word that fits a line breaks

button.field._source: Astryx ButtonGroup, one primary per group by meaning (qa2 #12): a form row's own action (Sync with browser, Generate archive, Flash image) is the secondary Button

button.primary._source: Astryx ButtonGroup: at most one primary (filled) Button in a group: the save bar, a dialog footer, a table cell, a section

table.actions._source: doona ActionGroup (owner 2026-11-21): a row's action buttons share one line, never stacked; where they do not fit, the first and a more menu (desktop and the phone fold's footer line)

dynlist._source: Dynlist (the SSH-keys page's add row, owner 2026-11-21): the + on its field's line, never under it

tabs.list._source: Astryx TabList overflow auto (always scrolls): one line of tabs at every width, scrolled sideways with edge fades (owner 2026-11-21: Channel Analysis)

tabs.pane._source: Astryx Tabs: one TabPanel shows, the selected tab's (panes of one group under one parent)

frame._source: Astryx Card: don't nest cards inside other cards; layout/structure: no Cards inside Cards. Only a frame inside a frame is listed (outside the components Astryx puts in a card)

dialog._source: Astryx Dialog: maxHeight 75dvh, the body scrolls between the title and the footer; the scrim covers the page, the save bar too

banner.icon._source: Astryx 0.7.16 Banner: gap icon -> text 8; a status dialog (ui.js displayStatus) keeps it

icon._source: qa2 #10: LuCI's device images (resources/icons/*.svg, bitmap look) are drawn as Heroicons; a showing one is listed

zone._source: qa2 #10: a firewall zone's inline colour as palette tokens (success, error, neutral, or mixed into the card), light and dark

glyph._source: Astryx draws icons (Heroicons), not characters: LuCI's ▾ ⇒ ∗ + × ··· are hidden and drawn as the icon; a showing one is listed

footer._source: Astryx LayoutFooter: the save bar is a region under the main column on a wide screen, so it covers no content (px of the main column under the bar)

space.page.inset._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: page inset 24 (LayoutContent) on top and both sides; bottom to the save bar where the page outgrows the column; the last block to an in-flow save bar (phone)

space.title.desc._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: page title -> its description 4 (tight step 1)

space.title.next._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: page title or description -> tabs or the first block 24 (page-level step)

space.tabs.content._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: tabs -> content 16, CBI ul.cbi-tabmenu and the view's div#tabmenu alike

space.block._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: block -> block in a column (cards, sections, tables, Add rows, groups) 16

space.card.pad._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: Card padding 16 from the outer edge to the content, top and bottom

space.heading.content._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: a section heading's own box -> its content 16 (no margin inside a title row)

space.descr.content._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: section description -> content 16

space.formrow.pad._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: FormLayout row padding 8 above and below (16 between rows)

space.label.field._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: label -> field 16 on one line (desktop), 4 stacked (phone; a toolbar's label over its control)

space.field.help._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: field -> help text 4

space.control.row._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: controls on one line 8 (buttons, field + button, checkbox + select, dialog footer)

space.dialog._source: lab spacing audit 2026-11-20, contract approved by the owner; Astryx Stack/Card/Dialog: the container owns the gap: Dialog padding top and bottom, title -> content, content -> footer 16

overflow._source: No card, table or scroll box inside a card or dialog is wider than it (scrollWidth - clientWidth); the Field and the phone Tabs list scroll by design and are skipped (uniform.mjs SCROLLS)

font.body.fontFamily: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Noto Sans TC Variable, PingFang TC, Microsoft JhengHei, Arial, sans-serif

font.code.fontFamily: ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, monospace
